mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum frxUSD (v3.0.1) can be minted and redeemed through six governance-approved FrxUSDCustodian contracts (USDB, WTGXX, BUIDL, USDC, USTB, and AUSD) with per-custodian caps; the token and all six custodians are owned by the 4/7 frxUSD owner/custodian admin Safe, which can directly raise custodian caps and remove minters, while token/five-custodian proxy upgrades, addMinter, setTimelock, and direct timelock minting require the 4/7 Safe to pass through a 24-hour timelock, and AUSD custodian proxy upgrades require the 3/5 Frax Comptroller Safe to pass through a separate 48-hour timelock. Fraxtal frxUSD3 (v3.0.0) exposes a direct minter_mint path with no source-level cap or max-supply check to a 3/5 Gnosis Safe acting as owner, timelock_address, direct minter, and zero-delay ProxyAdmin owner across the token and its two FrxUSDDistributor yield-minting proxies, which also authorize a single EOA bot to mint up to 20,000 frxUSD per UTC day combined (15,000 and 5,000 dailyPayCap) to whitelisted recipients; the Fraxtal L2 bridge, canonical-side lockboxes, and cross-chain OFT/TIP-20 representations are bridge machinery assessed separately under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: frxUSD upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: Re-verified at finalized Ethereum block 26491610 (2026-11-25T10:30:47.000Z, hash 0xac00e39ddaa80e32e1d8de3823f08d04cc45bcd36166c9b8d89fc9ecc7c070fc, keyless Alchemy RPC): the frxUSD token ProxyAdmin and the five FraxNet-documented custodian ProxyAdmins (USDB, WTGXX, BUIDL, USDC, USTB) all returned this verified Compound-style timelock as owner (whereas the AUSD custodian ProxyAdmin 0xf655414bfcd6f2b984474fe5d71ac62d19c98899 is owned by the 48-hour Frax Comptroller Timelock 0x8412ebf45bAC1B340BbE8F318b928C466c4E39CA). Its admin() was the 4-of-7 frxUSD owner/custodian admin Safe, pendingAdmin() was zero, and delay() was 86400 seconds (MINIMUM_DELAY 7200s, MAXIMUM_DELAY 2592000s, GRACE_PERIOD 1209600s). Following the block 26379419 v3.0.1 upgrade (tx 0xfa94523813f0f71c70b0fd07e993906ea8e0cd2d2f64f57f77958562c8c31111, emitting Upgraded(0x5c19d7c2838769ed3c5a1e506600940e62ff901f) and TimelockChanged(0x0, 0xb898Ad2976b4d8f2E21521C9db16b7497825E503)), frxUSD.timelock() and raw storage slot 15 both returned this timelock; verified v3.0.1 FrxUSD2.sol gates addMinter(address) and subsequent setTimelock(address) calls behind msg.sender == timelock. At block 26491610, frxUSD.minters(0xb898Ad2976b4d8f2E21521C9db16b7497825E503) also returned true (minters_array[8]), so the Safe must queue and wait 86400 seconds before executing proxy upgrades on the token or those five custodians, addMinter, setTimelock, or direct timelock minter_mint calls.

On-chain calls returned admin() = 0xB1748C79709f4Ba2Dd82834B8c82D4a505003f27 (3-of-5 Frax Comptroller Safe), pendingAdmin() = zero, delay() = 172800 seconds (48 hours; MINIMUM_DELAY 172800s, MAXIMUM_DELAY 2592000s, GRACE_PERIOD 1209600s), and frxUSD.minters(0x8412ebf45bAC1B340BbE8F318b928C466c4E39CA) = false. Upgrading the active AUSD custodian proxy could replace its mint logic after the 48-hour queue unless the 4-of-7 frxUSD owner Safe first revokes it via removeMinter.

controls.label: frxUSD owner/custodian admin Safe
controls.evidence: Re-verified at finalized Ethereum block 26491610 (2026-11-25T10:30:47.000Z, hash 0xac00e39ddaa80e32e1d8de3823f08d04cc45bcd36166c9b8d89fc9ecc7c070fc, keyless Alchemy RPC): frxUSD token owner(), all six custodian proxies' owner() (including the newly enrolled AUSD custodian 0x537bed9200Fc5a14AB56E554016753676eFf12B0), and upgrade timelock admin() returned this Safe (pendingOwner/pendingAdmin zero on frxUSD, AUSD custodian, and timelock), while frxUSD.minters(Safe) returned false. Under verified FrxUSD v3.0.1 (0x5c19d7c2838769ed3c5a1e506600940e62ff901f), addMinter and subsequent setTimelock calls require msg.sender == timelock (0xb898Ad2976b4d8f2E21521C9db16b7497825E503), so the Safe cannot directly authorize minters without queueing through the 86400-second timelock; it retains direct removeMinter and custodian setMintCap/fee authority (canRaiseCap true). Pinned eth_getCode returned empty bytes (0x, zero code length, not an EIP-7702 delegation) and eth_getTransactionCount returned 1148 (0x47c), confirming an active single-key EOA. Verified FrxUSDDistributor.payYield(address,uint256) allows msg.sender == bot to invoke frxUSD.minter_mint(_to, _amount) directly without collateral deposit up to each contract's dailyPayCap for whitelisted recipients.
